subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: A humanoid werewolf from<Picture 1>, with dense gray black wolf fur, heterochromatic wolf eyes, ancient black rune tattoos all over the body, wearing gilded gemstone chain jewelry, and holding two short curved knives in both hands; The blade releases dazzling and colorful starlight particle effects, with a style consistent with the sparkling starlight effect on the werewolf's head. Maintain the werewolf's appearance, fur, runes, gold jewelry, double swords, and starlight particle effects stable throughout the entire process. The combat style is mantis fist style close range compression: high-speed face contact, grappling, continuous angle slashing, always close to the opponent to suppress.
<Subject 2>: A rough East Asian warrior from<Picture 2>, with a scarred face, tied hair and beard, tattered coarse linen ancient style clothing, and holding a giant one handed heavy knife; As a lightning summoning tool, the giant sword unleashes surging blue lightning with its swing. Maintain stable facial scars, beards, coarse clothing, giant knives, and lightning abilities throughout the entire process. The combat style is a back punch style long-range heavy blow: swinging knives, chopping, and long-range blue lightning bursts, using lightning to open up space and counter werewolf melee.
<Scene Reference>: From<Picture 3>, a classical European style ancient city by the river on a moonlit night. Late at night, the full moon hangs high, with thick clouds and moonlight reflecting on the river surface. The ancient stone arch bridge, pointed buildings, and dark gravel ground on the riverbank. The screen retains the night, moonlight, river reflection, and ancient city outline, creating a cinematic depth battlefield.
summary:
[reference generation] Generate 25‑second,9:16,vertical screen,high‑impact fantasy combat one‑shot video. Continuous low‑angle tracking shot without cuts. Subject1 werewolf uses dual star‑particle blades for ferocious close‑quarters Mantis Fist assault. Subject2 warrior wields giant greatsword as lightning conduit, unleashing massive blue lightning counterattacks. Enhance extreme dynamic movement, dazzling star particles, spectacular blue lightning VFX, violent impact shockwaves, slow‑motion hit moments, fast camera orbiting, and vertical screen visual shock. Realistic CG movie texture with Chinese CG animation combat aesthetics.
retention_analysis:
<Subject1>: attribute_transfer， Retain the werewolf shape, fur, heterochromatic pupils, rune tattoo, gold-plated gemstone chain, double swords in Figure 1, and enhance the starlight particle effect.
<Subject2>: attribute_transfer， Retain the warrior's scarred face, beard, tattered coarse cloth clothing, giant heavy sword in Figure 2, and enhance the blue lightning summoning effect.
<Scene Reference>: partially_preserved， Adopting the atmosphere of the ancient city by the river on a moonlit night, the moonlit river surface, the stone arch bridge, and the pointed buildings, creating a high impact combat battlefield.
detailed_description:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic CG fantasy combat, realistic movie texture, dark moonlight lighting, high contrast rim light, film grain, volumetric fog, floating dust, continuous one‑shot low‑angle tracking camera, no hard cuts. Camera pushes in close, pulls back rapidly, orbits around fighters, tilts vertically to capture leaps, falls and lightning bursts.
0‑5s Opening vertical wide shot under full moon beside riverbank. The camera sits low near gravel ground, looking upward at both fighters. Subject1 werewolf drops into predatory mantis stance, dual blades swirling, dense multicolored star particles trail from his weapons like glowing galaxy dust. He explodes forward in extremely fast close‑quarters charge, paws kicking gravel into air, golden chains jangling violently. Subject2 raises giant greatsword, blue lightning begins to flicker along blade edge. The first clash happens in vertical close‑up: star‑particle blades strike greatsword, producing a violent circular shockwave, sparkling star fragments and blue electric sparks burst outward, camera shakes heavily.
5‑10s Combat enters high‑speed rhythm. Subject1 presses relentless close combat, slashing, hooking, grabbing and closing distance continuously. His dual blades leave bright star‑particle arcs in the air. Subject2 uses Tongbei‑style long whipping greatsword swings, each swing releases thick blue lightning arcs that twist like electric serpents across the screen. Lightning strikes the river surface, water erupts into steam columns;  lightning smashes the gravel shore, stone fragments fly upward in slow motion. Camera orbits rapidly around the fighters, vertical composition emphasizes height, jump, fall and weapon trajectory.
10‑16s Mid‑fight escalation. Subject1 feints, leaps, twists and attempts a leg takedown, body spinning low over the ground, star particles sweeping across the gravel like glowing blade wheels. Subject2 lifts greatsword overhead, channels massive blue lightning, and slams downward. A huge vertical lightning pillar crashes into the ground between them, illuminating the entire night scene with bright blue flash. The shockwave blasts Subject1 backward;  he rolls, recovers, and immediately charges again. Slow‑motion moment shows star particles colliding with lightning energy, creating a spectacular colorful explosion effect.
16‑21s Climax exchange of blows. Subject1 closes into extreme melee range, dual‑blade slashes become faster and wilder, star‑particle intensity flares to maximum, forming glowing afterimage trails around his arms. Subject2 grits his teeth, swings greatsword in a full circular arc, summoning a gigantic blue lightning slash that tears across the screen. The lightning wave collides with Subject1’s star‑particle blades, creating a brilliant vertical energy burst. Camera pushes extremely close to capture facial expressions: werewolf snarls in pain and fury, warrior’s face tensed with sweat and rage. Fur, beard, clothing, chains, tattoos and scars remain clearly identifiable under intense lightning light.
21‑25s Final mutual knockdown and standoff. Both fighters are hit by the combined energy shockwave. Subject1 slides backward on the left side of the vertical frame, paws digging deep grooves into gravel shore, star particles scattering around him. Subject2 skids backward on the right side, boots ploughing through loose stones, greatsword still glowing with fading blue lightning. They stop in exhausted combat stances, chests heaving violently under moonlight. The camera slowly pulls back to vertical wide shot, moon, river, ancient city and floating glowing particles form a spectacular final composition.
overall_soundscape:
Heavy combat soundscape, deep wolf growls and snarls, warrior grunts and ragged breathing, metallic blade clashes, fast weapon whooshes, crackling lightning thunder, stone shattering, gravel skittering, steam hiss, shockwave rumble, distant river water splash, golden chain jingles.
non_diegetic_music:
Epic dark orchestral fantasy soundtrack, low strings and heavy percussion at opening, rhythm accelerates during close combat, thunderous brass swells with lightning bursts, music reaches climax at final energy collision, then fades into tense sustained chords.

subject_definitions:

<Subject 1>如玉是来自<Picture 1>的成年女性角色。保留低马尾、棕灰色短袖针织上衣、米白色阔腿裤。她始终坐在柜台外侧画面右侧，面对<Subject 2>，神情平静谨慎。

<Subject 2>银行女职员是来自<Picture 2>的成年女性角色。保留贴头低髻、深藏蓝色合体银行西装外套、浅蓝色衬衫和胸前小型深色工牌。她始终坐在柜台内侧画面左侧，不换装、不增减配饰；禁止白衬衫单穿、休闲服、连衣裙、黑色西装、其他颜色制服或无外套造型。

<Subject 3>银行环境来自<Picture 3>与<Picture 4>。保留左侧落地窗、浅米色长业务柜台、浅绿色玻璃隔断、米色立柱、冷白顶灯、浅色地砖与金属椅。如玉正拍或过银行女职员左肩镜头时，必须保留<Picture 4>中的浅米色柜台、虚化绿色玻璃隔断、虚化蓝色文件夹、冷白柔光和背景景深。

<Subject 4>业务确认文件是一份斜向平放的白色银行业务文件。签字与按手印前，始终位于如玉面前、靠近如玉身体一侧的柜台外沿。文件顶部与模糊标题区域朝向画面左下角；签名空白线朝向画面右上角、靠近如玉。右手大拇指手印直接按在刚写完的签名名字上方，部分覆盖签名字迹，不设独立手印空白区。所有文字不可读，文件不得旋转、翻面或移位。

<Subject 5>黑色签字笔从开始就静置在如玉右手边、柜台外侧。全程只由如玉拿起、签字、放回原位，银行女职员不拿、不推、不收。

<Subject 6>牛皮纸资料袋是一个浅棕色、无Logo、无文字的A4牛皮纸文件袋，位于如玉右手边。银行女职员递交的全部办结资料由如玉亲手装入袋内；如玉离开时必须拿走这个牛皮纸资料袋。

<Subject 7>红色印泥盒与业务印章无品牌、无可读文字。印章只呈现真实红色盖印质感。

summary:

[reference generation] 生成一段写实竖屏都市家庭短剧。银行柜台前，如玉坐在画面右侧，银行女职员坐在画面左侧。如玉在自己面前斜向摆放的文件右上侧签字，再以右手大拇指在刚写完的名字上按下红色手印。银行女职员盖章、递交办结文件；如玉将全部资料装进牛皮纸袋后，带着资料袋离开。

<Subject 1>（出现在[Shot 1]、[Shot 2]、[Shot 3]、[Shot 4]、[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 保留<Picture 1>的人物身份、低马尾、棕灰色短袖和米白色阔腿裤。始终位于柜台外侧画面右侧，不改变座位关系。

<Subject 2>（出现在[Shot 1]、[Shot 2]、[Shot 4]、[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 保留<Picture 2>的人物身份、贴头低髻、深藏蓝色西装外套、浅蓝色衬衫和深色工牌。始终位于柜台内侧画面左侧，不换装，不触碰<Subject 5>。

<Subject 3>（出现在[Shot 1]、[Shot 2]、[Shot 3]、[Shot 4]、[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 保留<Picture 3>的银行整体空间与<Picture 4>中如玉背后的局部背景。浅米色柜台、浅绿色玻璃隔断、虚化蓝色文件夹、冷白柔光和景深关系不可改变。

<Subject 4>（出现在[Shot 1]、[Shot 2]、[Shot 3]、[Shot 4]、[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 文件始终斜向摆放，顶部和标题朝向画面左下角，签名线朝向画面右上角、靠近如玉。右手大拇指红色指印必须直接覆盖刚签下的名字，不得生成独立手印区。

<Subject 5>（出现在[Shot 2]、[Shot 3]、[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 始终位于如玉右手边柜台外侧，只由<Subject 1>使用，签字后回到原位，不被带走。

<Subject 6>（出现在[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 保持浅棕色牛皮纸材质、无Logo、无文字。办结资料必须被<Subject 1>完整放入<Subject 6>，并由她带离画面。

<Subject 7>（出现在[Shot 3]、[Shot 4]）：fully_preserved - 红色印泥盒由<Subject 2>推至文件附近；如玉只用右手大拇指按印。业务印章只由<Subject 2>在如玉完成签字与按印后使用。

detailed_description:

整体为写实、克制的都市家庭短剧，竖屏9:16。冷白自然日光透过左侧落地窗，与柔和顶灯共同照亮浅米色柜台和浅绿色玻璃隔断。所有镜头严格匹配<Subject 3>的空间结构、光线和景深。禁止字幕、画面文字、对白气泡、可读文件、银行Logo、水印和背景音乐。

[Shot 1] 银行女职员深藏蓝西装的左肩作为画面左下方轻微虚化前景，中近景正对<Subject 1>如玉。<Subject 1>坐在柜台外侧画面右侧，身后是<Subject 3>中浅米色柜台、虚化绿色玻璃隔断和蓝色文件夹。<Subject 4>斜向平放在她面前，文件顶部和模糊标题朝画面左下角，签名线朝画面右上角、靠近如玉。她右手轻扶文件右上角，视线看向画面左侧的<Subject 2>，低声问：<d>[Chinese] 我能替他取用这笔钱吗？</d> 说完闭嘴等待。

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000，切至<Subject 2>银行女职员中近景。<Subject 1>的右肩与发尾在画面右前景轻微虚化。<Subject 2>清晰保持贴头低髻、深藏蓝色合体西装外套、浅蓝衬衫和胸前深色工牌。她只用手势示意<Subject 1>面前的<Subject 4>，专业回答：<d>[Chinese] 生活、教育和医疗等必要支出，可以按规定申请。但不能自行挪用，也不能用于投资。</d> <Subject 5>始终静置在如玉右手边柜台外侧。

[Shot 3] At 00:06.800，切至如玉手部与半身近景。<Subject 4>清楚位于如玉面前、靠近她身体一侧的柜台外沿，并保持斜向：文件顶部和标题区域朝画面左下角；签名空白线朝画面右上角、紧邻如玉。

<Subject 1>从画面右侧伸出右手，拿起<Subject 5>，在画面右上角的签名空白线完成签名。签名内容不可读。签完后，她将<Subject 5>轻轻放回自己右手边、柜台外侧的原位。

detailed_description:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic CG fantasy combat, realistic movie texture, dark moonlight lighting, high contrast rim light, film grain, volumetric fog, floating dust, continuous one‑shot low‑angle tracking camera, no hard cuts. Camera pushes in close, pulls back rapidly, orbits around fighters, tilts vertically to capture leaps, falls and lightning bursts.
0‑5s Opening vertical wide shot under full moon beside riverbank. The camera sits low near gravel ground, looking upward at both fighters. Subject1 werewolf drops into predatory mantis stance, dual blades swirling, dense multicolored star particles trail from his weapons like glowing galaxy dust. He explodes forward in extremely fast close‑quarters charge, paws kicking gravel into air, golden chains jangling violently. Subject2 raises giant greatsword, blue lightning begins to flicker along blade edge. The first clash happens in vertical close‑up: star‑particle blades strike greatsword, producing a violent circular shockwave, sparkling star fragments and blue electric sparks burst outward, camera shakes heavily.
5‑10s Combat enters high‑speed rhythm. Subject1 presses relentless close combat, slashing, hooking, grabbing and closing distance continuously. His dual blades leave bright star‑particle arcs in the air. Subject2 uses Tongbei‑style long whipping greatsword swings, each swing releases thick blue lightning arcs that twist like electric serpents across the screen. Lightning strikes the river surface, water erupts into steam columns;  lightning smashes the gravel shore, stone fragments fly upward in slow motion. Camera orbits rapidly around the fighters, vertical composition emphasizes height, jump, fall and weapon trajectory.
10‑16s Mid‑fight escalation. Subject1 feints, leaps, twists and attempts a leg takedown, body spinning low over the ground, star particles sweeping across the gravel like glowing blade wheels. Subject2 lifts greatsword overhead, channels massive blue lightning, and slams downward. A huge vertical lightning pillar crashes into the ground between them, illuminating the entire night scene with bright blue flash. The shockwave blasts Subject1 backward;  he rolls, recovers, and immediately charges again. Slow‑motion moment shows star particles colliding with lightning energy, creating a spectacular colorful explosion effect.
16‑21s Climax exchange of blows. Subject1 closes into extreme melee range, dual‑blade slashes become faster and wilder, star‑particle intensity flares to maximum, forming glowing afterimage trails around his arms. Subject2 grits his teeth, swings greatsword in a full circular arc, summoning a gigantic blue lightning slash that tears across the screen. The lightning wave collides with Subject1’s star‑particle blades, creating a brilliant vertical energy burst. Camera pushes extremely close to capture facial expressions: werewolf snarls in pain and fury, warrior’s face tensed with sweat and rage. Fur, beard, clothing, chains, tattoos and scars remain clearly identifiable under intense lightning light.
21‑25s Final mutual knockdown and standoff. Both fighters are hit by the combined energy shockwave. Subject1 slides backward on the left side of the vertical frame, paws digging deep grooves into gravel shore, star particles scattering around him. Subject2 skids backward on the right side, boots ploughing through loose stones, greatsword still glowing with fading blue lightning. They stop in exhausted combat stances, chests heaving violently under moonlight. The camera slowly pulls back to vertical wide shot, moon, river, ancient city and floating glowing particles form a spectacular final composition.
overall_soundscape:
Heavy combat soundscape, deep wolf growls and snarls, warrior grunts and ragged breathing, metallic blade clashes, fast weapon whooshes, crackling lightning thunder, stone shattering, gravel skittering, steam hiss, shockwave rumble, distant river water splash, golden chain jingles.
non_diegetic_music:
Epic dark orchestral fantasy soundtrack, low strings and heavy percussion at opening, rhythm accelerates during close combat, thunderous brass swells with lightning bursts, music reaches climax at final energy collision, then fades into tense sustained chords.
